name: subagent-orchestration
description: Codex multi_agent_v2 orchestration patterns, prompts, hooks, and bundled agent definitions for safe parallel delegation, commit checkpoints, and clean root threads.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate aggressively with safe parallelism, checkpoints, and clean root threads
interface.longDescription: Use Subagent Orchestration to decide when to spawn Codex multi_agent_v2 subagents, how to maximize safe parallel work without file ownership conflicts, when to use organizer, lead, and leaf-agent workflows, and how to require validated commit checkpoints while keeping the root conversation clean.
defaultPrompt: Use subagents to split this work without polluting the root thread.
Design a parallel-safe multi-agent plan with clear file ownership and commit checkpoints.
Delegate this implementation to lead and leaf agents, committing validated checkpoints as they go.
